review: The proposed Base64 declaration check is materially different from the closed SHA-whitespace seam: it targets decoder normalization before exact payload-byte verification. Keep exact raw stored identity separate from canonical decoded bytes. A repair may compare raw stored Base64 to the writer-equivalent canonical re-encoding, but must not trim, remove whitespace, repair padding, or otherwise normalize the persisted declaration into acceptance. Source policy/test/skill/art may advance now. Existing-owner wiring remains a separate capability state unless actually edited and read back through GitHub.
